newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo to launch truck line in 1998 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Volvo to launch truck line in 1998 - paper.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo's truck division will present a new line of vehicles in 1998 to replace its FL model, Swedish business daily Dagens Industri said on Friday.
Development costs for the new model, which will be called the Volvo FM, will total between two and four billion crowns, the newspaper said.
Volvo's FL model is used for regional distribution and construction and accounts for 30 to 40 percent of Volvo Truck's sales in Europe.
Volvo declined to comment on the report of the model or the figure, but repeated that it planned to introduce a heavy duty truck range by the year 2000.

"It's no secret and we have said it before that before 2000 we will introduce a heavy duty truck range based on the FH concept and that will surely include the FL range," Volvo Truck spokesman Stefan Lorentzson told Reuters.
Volvo Trucks is developing a product range which will share a large percentage of components. The Volvo FH series is the platform for these models.
